claims.title: 12-inch Retina notebook
claims.outcome: Apple introduced a 12-inch Retina MacBook.

claims.title: One USB-C port for charging and data
claims.outcome: The 2015 MacBook used a single USB-C connector.

claims.title: No MagSafe connector on the new notebook
claims.outcome: Charging moved to USB-C.

claims.title: No full-size USB or SD-card slot
claims.outcome: The new MacBook omitted both interfaces.

claims.title: Thinner and lighter notebook design
claims.outcome: Apple specified 2 pounds and 13.1 mm.

claims.title: New 12-inch notebook described as MacBook Air
claims.outcome: The hardware became MacBook, without Air branding. The report does not clearly distinguish a predicted retail name from a working description.
claims.note: Naming discrepancy recorded; no forced branding miss.

claims.title: 12-megapixel rear cameras on iPhone 6s
claims.outcome: Both 6s sizes included a 12 MP rear camera.

claims.title: 4K recording on iPhone 6s
claims.outcome: Apple added 4K video recording.

claims.title: Display-based flash for selfies
claims.outcome: Retina Flash illuminated the display for selfies.

claims.title: iPhone SE retains the iPhone 5s form
claims.outcome: The first SE retained the compact 4-inch enclosure.

claims.title: Matte edges on iPhone SE
claims.outcome: Apple specified matte-chamfered edges.

claims.title: A9 processor in iPhone SE
claims.outcome: The SE used A9.

claims.title: Always-on Hey Siri on iPhone SE
claims.outcome: M9 enabled hands-free Siri.

claims.title: Apple Pay on iPhone SE
claims.outcome: Apple included NFC and Apple Pay.

claims.title: 12 MP camera and 4K on iPhone SE
claims.outcome: Both camera specifications shipped.

claims.title: iPhone SE introduced March 21
claims.outcome: Apple announced it on March 21.

claims.title: 9.7-inch iPad Pro uses A9X
claims.outcome: Apple shipped A9X.

claims.title: Smaller iPad Pro supports Apple Pencil
claims.outcome: Apple Pencil support shipped.

claims.title: Four speakers on smaller iPad Pro
claims.outcome: Apple specified a four-speaker system.

claims.title: Smart Connector and matching keyboard
claims.outcome: The smaller Pro supported a fitted Smart Keyboard.

claims.title: 12 MP camera with 4K recording
claims.outcome: Apple shipped a 12 MP camera and 4K recording.

claims.title: 9.7-inch iPad Pro starts at $599
claims.outcome: The Wi-Fi model started at $599.

claims.title: iPad Air 2 remains at likely $499
claims.outcome: Apple retained iPad Air 2 at $399, rather than $499.

claims.outcome: iPhone 7 introduced a solid-state Home button.

claims.title: Headphone jack removed from iPhone 7
claims.outcome: Apple moved wired audio to Lightning.

claims.title: Dual rear cameras on the larger iPhone
claims.outcome: iPhone 7 Plus had wide and telephoto cameras.

claims.title: Stereo speakers on iPhone 7
claims.outcome: Apple introduced stereo speakers.

claims.title: Contextual touch strip above the keyboard
claims.outcome: Apple introduced Touch Bar.

claims.title: Touch ID on the new MacBook Pro
claims.outcome: Touch ID shipped on Touch Bar models.

claims.title: Thinner MacBook Pro enclosure
claims.outcome: Apple announced a thinner and lighter design.

claims.title: Face recognition intended to replace Touch ID
claims.outcome: iPhone X introduced Face ID for unlocking and Apple Pay.

claims.title: Apple testing 120 Hz iPhone displays
claims.outcome: iPhone X lacked ProMotion; that does not disprove the report that a prototype was tested.

claims.title: Cellular Apple Watch by end of 2017
claims.outcome: Series 3 GPS + Cellular became available September 22.

claims.title: Screenless Siri speaker expected
claims.outcome: HomePod shipped with Siri and no screen.

claims.title: Siri speaker could be unveiled at WWDC
claims.outcome: Apple previewed HomePod June 5.
claims.note: Possibility matched; excluded from binary expectation totals.

claims.title: Siri speaker expected to ship later in 2017
claims.outcome: HomePod reached customers February 9, 2018.

claims.title: Face ID on the 2018 iPad Pro
claims.outcome: The redesigned Pro used Face ID.

claims.title: Home button removed from iPad Pro
claims.outcome: The 2018 redesign removed the Home button.

claims.title: LCD retained instead of OLED
claims.outcome: Liquid Retina used LCD.

claims.title: Updated Apple Pencil alongside iPad
claims.outcome: Second-generation Apple Pencil accompanied the Pro.

claims.title: Macs begin moving to Apple processors around 2020
claims.outcome: The transition was announced in June 2020; M1 Macs shipped in November.
claims.note: Supports direction and earliest suggested year; no hard deadline inferred.

claims.title: New entry notebook expected below $1,000
claims.outcome: The new Retina MacBook Air launched at $1,199.
claims.note: The retained older $999 Air is not the forecast new notebook.

claims.title: New education-oriented iPad at March event
claims.outcome: Apple introduced the sixth-generation iPad on March 27.

claims.title: Retina display in a 13-inch MacBook Air
claims.outcome: Apple introduced a 13.3-inch Retina Air.

claims.title: Slimmer display borders on MacBook Air
claims.outcome: The redesigned Air reduced display borders.

claims.title: Mac mini refresh with stronger processor options
claims.outcome: Apple introduced quad- and six-core options.

claims.title: Refreshed Mac mini likely more expensive
claims.outcome: The new mini started at $799.

claims.title: Hands-free Hey Siri in next AirPods
claims.outcome: Second-generation AirPods added hands-free Siri in March 2019.

claims.title: AirPods update possible as soon as 2018
claims.outcome: The update shipped in 2019. An earliest possibility does not establish a 2018 deadline.

claims.title: Higher-end AirPods with noise cancellation
claims.outcome: AirPods Pro introduced active noise cancellation.

claims.title: Water-resistant higher-end AirPods
claims.outcome: AirPods Pro carried an IPX4 rating.

claims.outcome: AirPods Pro became available October 30, 2019.

claims.title: Over-ear headphones targeted for early 2019
claims.outcome: AirPods Max arrived December 15, 2020.

claims.title: Another HomePod possible as early as 2019
claims.outcome: HomePod mini arrived in 2020 and HomePod 2 in 2023. Neither establishes whether a 2019 possibility was reasonable.

claims.title: AirPower on sale by September 2018
claims.outcome: Apple cancelled AirPower in March 2019 after no 2018 launch.

claims.title: 10.2-inch iPad later in 2019

claims.title: Cheaper HomePod with fewer tweeters

claims.title: LiDAR on both premium iPhones

claims.title: AI processing split between devices and cloud
claims.outcome: Apple introduced Private Cloud Compute.

claims.title: AI editing features for Photos
claims.outcome: Apple announced the Clean Up tool.

claims.title: M4 and M4 Pro options for Mac mini
claims.outcome: Apple offered both processors.

claims.title: Substantially smaller Mac mini enclosure
claims.outcome: The redesigned mini measured 5 by 5 inches.

claims.title: New mini slightly taller than 1.4 inches
claims.outcome: Apple specified a 2-inch height.

claims.title: Aluminum enclosure retained
claims.outcome: Apple retained an aluminum enclosure.

claims.title: Redesigned M4 Mac mini during 2024
claims.outcome: Apple announced it October 29 and made it available November 8.

claims.title: M4-family MacBook Pro in 2024
claims.outcome: Apple announced M4, M4 Pro and M4 Max MacBook Pros in October.

claims.title: M4 iMac during 2024
claims.outcome: M4 iMac arrived November 8.

claims.title: M4 MacBook Air in spring 2025
claims.outcome: M4 Air arrived March 12.
claims.note: Spring means March–May for this provisional review; an astronomical-season reading would change the timing verdict.

claims.title: Mac Studio moves to M4 generation in 2025
claims.outcome: The 2025 Studio offered M4 Max, alongside M3 Ultra.
claims.note: Support is limited to an M4-family option; not every Studio configuration used M4.

claims.title: iPhone 16 Pro screens grow to 6.3 and 6.9 inches
claims.outcome: Apple introduced those display sizes.

claims.title: Dedicated camera-control button on Pro iPhones
claims.outcome: Camera Control shipped on the iPhone 16 lineup.

claims.title: Swipe gestures for camera zoom
claims.outcome: Camera Control supported sliding to adjust zoom.

claims.title: All three Apple Watch lines updated at event
claims.outcome: Series 10 launched; Ultra 2 gained black titanium. There was no Ultra 3 or new SE.

claims.title: Apple Watch Ultra 3 with internal upgrades
claims.outcome: Apple retained Ultra 2 in 2024. Ultra 3 arrived in September 2025.

claims.title: Larger, thinner Apple Watch Series 10
claims.outcome: Series 10 offered 42/46 mm cases and a thinner design.

claims.title: Hypertension detection delayed beyond 2024 Watch
claims.outcome: Series 10 launched without hypertension notifications.

claims.title: Hearing-test and hearing-aid features announced
claims.outcome: Apple announced them for AirPods Pro 2; availability followed in October.
claims.note: Announcement forecast, not immediate availability; the report allows a later release.

claims.title: Apple modem in the next low-cost iPhone
claims.outcome: iPhone 16e introduced C1.

claims.title: A18 and Apple Intelligence support
claims.outcome: Both shipped in iPhone 16e.

claims.title: USB-C on the next low-cost iPhone
claims.outcome: iPhone 16e used USB-C.

claims.title: Single 48 MP rear camera
claims.outcome: Apple specified a 48 MP Fusion camera.

claims.title: Face ID replaces the SE Home button
claims.outcome: The successor used Face ID.

claims.title: Next low-cost iPhone expected below $500
claims.outcome: iPhone 16e launched at $599.
claims.note: The price sentence does not explicitly repeat Gurman attribution. Original Bloomberg wording is needed before assigning this miss to him.

claims.title: Next low-cost iPhone released later in February
claims.outcome: 16e became available February 28.

claims.title: Low-cost iPhone announced by the following week
claims.outcome: Apple announced iPhone 16e February 19.
claims.note: Retrospective normalization: the following Monday–Sunday week ends February 23. Not the original forecast date.

claims.title: Thinner iPhone joins 2025 lineup
claims.outcome: Apple introduced iPhone Air in September 2025.

claims.title: Apple-designed modem in the thin iPhone
claims.outcome: iPhone Air used C1X.

claims.title: Thin iPhone roughly 2 mm thinner than 16 Pro
claims.outcome: iPhone Air was 5.6 mm versus 8.25 mm, a 2.65 mm difference. No tolerance for roughly was specified.
claims.note: Numerical discrepancy shown without inventing an acceptable-error band.

claims.title: AirTag 2 around the middle of 2025
claims.outcome: The second-generation AirTag was introduced January 26, 2026.
claims.note: Announcement and ordering were in 2026, beyond any ordinary mid-2025 reading.

claims.title: Home hub between October and early next year
claims.outcome: The reported window had not begun at the September 5 review.
claims.note: Newest open revision retained; no success or failure assigned.

claims.title: Home hub with 7-inch display and mounting options
claims.outcome: Unreleased feature expectations remain open.

claims.title: First Apple Watch ships in the US by end of March
claims.outcome: Initial US customer availability was April 24, after the March window.
claims.note: The 2014 preview does not satisfy a 2015 shipping forecast.

claims.title: Second-generation Watch unveiled in March 2016
claims.outcome: Series 2 was unveiled September 7, 2016.

claims.title: Second-generation Watch ships by April 2016
claims.outcome: Series 2 became available September 16, 2016.
claims.note: By April is normalized generously through the end of April; the September outcome misses either reading.

claims.title: Consumer display below Pro Display XDR price
claims.outcome: Studio Display launched at $1,599 versus $4,999 for Pro Display XDR.
claims.note: Supports the eventual product attributes; does not independently confirm internal early-development work or give a launch deadline.

claims.title: Lower brightness than Pro Display XDR
claims.outcome: Studio Display specified 600 nits, below Pro Display XDR’s 1,000 nits sustained full-screen rating.

claims.title: Siri debuts on Mac with the 10.12 release
claims.outcome: macOS Sierra 10.12 brought Siri to the Mac.

claims.title: Menu-bar access to Siri on Mac
claims.outcome: Sierra exposed Siri through the menu bar, Dock and keyboard.

claims.title: OS 10.12 with Siri introduced at June WWDC
claims.outcome: Apple previewed macOS Sierra on June 13.
